title: Webull Powers Launch of MOUM, Meritz Securities' Next-Generation AI Investment Platform

body_markdown:
*New platform brings Korean retail investors access to U.S. Markets, Webull Community and Vega's AI-tools.*


ST. PETERSBURG, Fla.


, Oct. 1, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- Webull Corporation (NASDAQ:BULL ), a global financial technology company, today announced it is powering MOUM, Meritz Securities' next-generation investment platform. MOUM combines access to Webull's proprietary Vega AI tools, global investor community, and U.S. equities markets with Meritz Securities' AI-forward, digital investing experience.


The launch[builds on the strategic partnership](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/webull-announces-strategic-partnership-with-meritz-financial-group-to-broaden-access-to-global-markets-and-enter-south-korea-302613105.html) between Webull and Meritz, first announced in November 2025, and represents an important milestone in Webull's plans to expand access to AI-powered investment services to retail investors.


"We're proud to power MOUM with Webull's technology, bringing together AI, social investing, and access to U.S. markets to create an intelligent and informed user experience for Korean retail investors," said **Jack Keating, CEO of Webull Technologies Inc.** "This launch demonstrates how our technology can help financial institutions leverage Webull services to deliver next-generation investing experiences around the world."


A core feature of MOUM is Vega AI, Webull's proprietary investment intelligence engine. The technology is designed to help investors navigate the growing volume of information required to make informed investment decisions, enabling users to quickly analyze company filings, earnings reports and news.


MOUM also integrates Webull Community, a real-time global investor community, giving Korean investors access to conversations and perspectives from investors around the world.


Meritz Securities is the first Korean brokerage to offer Webull's Vega AI and access to Webull's Community.


"MOUM is built on a simple belief: that a truly borderless investment experience is something you build together, not alone," said **Jangwook Lee, EVP & Head of Innobiz Division, Meritz Securities** . "Our partnership with Webull is central to that vision, connecting Korean investors seamlessly to global markets, and bringing world-class technology into a single, unified journey. This launch is not a destination, but the beginning of the future of investing we are creating with our partners."


For more information on MOUM, please visit:[https://link.moum.me/](https://link.moum.me/)


**###**


**About Webull Corporation**


Webull Corporation (NASDAQ: BULL) owns and operates Webull, a leading digital investment platform built on next-generation global infrastructure and AI technologies. Through its global network of licensed brokerages, Webull offers investment services in 18 markets across North America, Asia Pacific, Europe, Africa, and Latin America. Webull serves more than 28 million registered users globally, providing retail and institutional investors with 24/7 access to global financial markets. Users can put investment strategies to work by trading global stocks, ETFs, options, futures, fractional shares, and digital assets through Webull's trading platform, which seamlessly integrates market data and information, its user community, and investor education resources. Learn more at[www.webullcorp.com](http://www.webullcorp.com/) .


**About Meritz Securities**


Meritz Securities Co., Ltd., founded in 1973, is the flagship securities firm within the Meritz Financial Group. The company offers a comprehensive range of investment banking, brokerage, asset management, and trust services for both individual and institutional clients. Driven by its digital transformation strategy, Meritz continues to integrate AI, cloud technologies, and global partnerships to deliver smarter and more accessible financial experiences. Leveraging its strengths in corporate finance and digital innovation, Meritz aims to build a next-generation global investment ecosystem connecting investors worldwide. For more information, visit[www.imeritz.com](http://www.imeritz.com/) .
